summary: Backend-only test of the nonstop AI prospecting changes (no daily cap, 12 angles, angles_v2 one-time migration, hourly watchdog cron endpoint + overview fields + crons.yml), plus regression of requeue/AI-credit suites. All 9 new watchdog/cap/angle/migration tests pass. The regression suites now fail (7/18), and the cause is a real bug: the upstream LLM error changed to a Gemini 429 'You exceeded your current quota' (RateLimitError / RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED), and _QUOTA_MARKERS does not match it. So AiCreditsOut is never raised, the worker does not stop early, ai_blocked_at is not set, and enrich attempts are used up, which marks brands 'failed'.

critical.issue: The current quota error from the provider is 'litellm.RateLimitError ... GeminiException {"code": 429, "message": "You exceeded your current quota..."}'. None of the markers ('spend limit','budget','insufficient balance','insufficient_quota') match it. Result: lanes keep calling the LLM for the full 14-min batch (22-34 failed discover calls in about 100s). ai_blocked_at is not set, so the overview shows no credit banner. enrich() counts these as normal failures and brands go to status=failed after 3 tries. requeue_failed's quota regex also misses them, so they only come back after the 6h cooldown and count toward the max 5 rounds. Failed discover calls also add to stats.discover_runs. This is the cause of the 7 regression failures in test_prospecting_requeue.py and test_prospecting_ai_credits.py.

minor.issue: watchdog_action is written as 'restarted' whenever idle and not running, even when prospecting is disabled and the route does not spawn run_worker. The overview then shows a restart that never happened. Pass 'enabled' into watchdog() or write 'idle-disabled'.

Freeing a stuck lock does not cancel the hung coroutine. When that old run finally finishes, its finally block sets until='' and can release the lock held by the new watchdog-started batch, so two workers can run at once. Consider a run token check in the finally block.

daily_cap still reads the persisted doc value (int(doc.get('daily_cap') or 0)). In preview the doc has no daily_cap, so it is 0 and the test passes. If the production settings doc still stores daily_cap=500 from before, the cap stays active. Unset it with a one-time migration or ignore the field.

action_items: Add Gemini/LiteLLM quota markers to _QUOTA_MARKERS and to the requeue_failed quota regex, e.g. 'exceeded your current quota', 'resource_exhausted', 'quota'. Or check isinstance on litellm RateLimitError when the message contains 'quota'. Then re-run tests/test_prospecting_ai_credits.py and tests/test_prospecting_requeue.py.
Do not write watchdog_action='restarted' when prospecting is disabled and nothing was spawned.
Guard run_worker's finally block so a freed, stuck run cannot clear the lock of a newer run.
Make sure no stored daily_cap is left in the production 'prospecting' settings doc.
critical_code_review_comments: Quota detection by error text is brittle. The provider wording already changed from 'Daily spend limit reached' to the Gemini 429 'exceeded your current quota'.
A failed discover() returns {'added':0} without increasing runs/empty_streak, so on persistent errors _next_discovery keeps picking the same lowest-runs categories in a busy loop.
test_prospecting_requeue.py teardown sets prospecting enabled=True. That conflicts with the preview rule that it must stay disabled. Change it to restore the original value.
Hot reload: editing any file under /app/backend restarts the backend. If enabled=true at that moment, _seed_defaults spawns run_worker('startup'). Keep this in mind when tests toggle enabled.

success_rate.backend: New features 9/9 (100%). Regression 11/18 (61%) - 7 failures share one cause: undetected 429 quota error

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_Land/TEST_wd_cat prospect_cats doc, removed afterwards. The prospect_angles_v2 flag was absent before and was deleted again in teardown. Then the regression suite (as intended) re-created it, so it is now present in preview. Data side effect: while enabled, the workers hit the undetected 429 and marked 8 real preview prospects failed or used up their attempts (ids 2,26,27,107,138,139,177,235), and set contacts_status=failed on 4 (864,2184,2557,2725). I reverted these to status=discovered, enrich_attempts=0, contacts_status unset. retry_rounds/contacts_retry_rounds may have gone up by 1 on pre-existing failed docs through requeue_failed. prospect_lock fields (started/trigger/last_finished/ai_blocked_*/watchdog_*) were restored to their pre-test values. last_stats was overwritten. prospect_cats saturated/empty_streak were restored from backup after my test. The migration also ran during the regression suite (all were saturated=false already).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the prospecting suites serially with -n 0: tests/test_prospecting_watchdog.py (~45s), then test_prospecting_requeue.py and test_prospecting_ai_credits.py. These run real workers against the preview LLM key, which is out of quota. Do not edit backend files while tests have enabled=true, because hot reload triggers a startup worker. ALWAYS set settings key 'prospecting' enabled=false at the end (requeue test teardown sets it to true). Watchdog secret is WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET in /app/backend/.env.
rca of the issue: Regression failures: _ask only maps errors containing 'spend limit|budget|insufficient balance|insufficient_quota' to AiCreditsOut. The preview key now fails with Gemini 429 'You exceeded your current quota' (last_error is truncated to 200 chars and doesn't even keep the message). So the error falls into the generic except branch: discover logs and continues, enrich increments attempts and marks failed at 3, and the lanes never stop. Reproduce: set prospecting enabled=true, POST /api/prospecting/run, and watch prospect_runs (all ok=false 429), with prospect_lock.ai_blocked_at not updated and the batch still running after 90s. Fix: extend the markers (e.g. 'quota', 'resource_exhausted').
